item.title: ACMobility Opens Manila's First EV Charging Hub
item.description: ACMobility, the country’s leading provider of end-to-end electric mobility solutions, on Monday opened the first publicly accessible electric vehicle charging hub in the city of Manila, with two more lined up through its collaboration with the city government. Read More »

item.title: Hyundai Motor's Talent Academy Cultivates Next Generation Of Global Service Professionals
item.description: Hyundai Motor Company has concluded its 2026 Hyundai Service Talent Academy training program, a five-day initiative that develops the next generation of global service professionals. Read More »

item.title: Ford Libis Celebrates 25 Years, Looks To Next Chapter As A Ford Signature 2.0 Dealership By Year-End
item.description: Ford Libis, operated by the Laus Group of Companies, has celebrated its 25 milestone years in the Philippines, marking the milestone with a renewed commitment to provide its growing customer base an elevated ownership experience, including the future of automotive retail. Read More »

item.title: The VinFast VF 3 Is The Philippines' Best-Selling EV
item.description: The VinFast VF 3—VinFast’s self-proclaimed “Tiny Titan” is the Philippines’ best-selling battery electric vehicle. According to the January to August 2026 sales data from CAMPI-TMA , the VF 3 sold 2,906 units putting it at the top of the sales chart. Read More »
